other_conditions: Must be a member of Handloom Weaver Co‑operative Societies, Handloom Associations/Organisations, or Karnataka Development Corporation
Must reside in own house or rented house
Traditional weavers must be currently practising handloom weaving
Must possess a Weaver’s Identity Card
Young entrants must have completed handloom weaving training under any government scheme and hold the relevant certificate
For purchase of a warping machine, the weaver must have a certificate of experience in washing and sufficient space to install the machine
benefits_summary: Provides a 50% subsidy on the cost of new handloom equipment, disbursed in two halves after verification and purchase.
